title: Inessive Personal Pronouns: bennem, benned, benne...

sections.content:
Hungarian case suffixes inflect like nouns when combined with personal possessive endings. The inessive case (*-ban / -ben*, meaning 'in') becomes a personal pronoun paradigm based on the stem **benn-**:
- **bennem** = in me
- **benned** = in you (singular informal)
- **benne** = in him / in her / in it
- **bennünk** = in us
- **bennetek** = in you (plural informal)
- **bennük** = in them

items.english: I trust in you / I believe in you.
I was not disappointed in you all.
